# The RG DS Plus's own Linux (ANBERNIC-rk3568-keys): its built-in mapping puts the
# face buttons by their letters (a is the right button); here by position, as
# SDL means them (a bottom, b right, x left, y top). Raw buttons: 0 A (right),
# 1 B (bottom), 2 Y (left), 3 X (top).
